item.kubejs.frozen_terracube_core.toolti: Dropped when a Terracube is killed by freezing damage. Use in cold biomes to summon the Icy Terracube
command.kubejs.item_list.parts.name: Part list of %s
command.kubejs.item_list.parts.lore: Contained every part of the material

death.attack.kubejs.papercut: %1$s got a paper cut while tearing %2$s's armor
death.attack.kubejs.papercut.player: %1$s got a pepr cut from %3$s while tearing %2$s's armor
death.attack.kubejs.hot_tool: %s thought their hands were made of iron
death.attack.kubejs.icy_terracube_smash: %1$s was smashed by %2$s and became part of the earth
material.kubejs.soil.flavor: Totally natural material! May get your hands dirty.
material.kubejs.soil.encyclopedia: The tool has a chance of level×20% to drop durability points by (1~3)×level every tick
material.kubejs.brick.encyclopedia: Deals multiplied damage on critical hits, 5% per level. Consumes 25% of remaining durability when triggered, at least 10 points
material.kubejs.coal.encyclopedia: Attack an enemy can set your tool on fire. During this time, tool will continuously lose its durability points, and set fire to other enemies as you attack
material.kubejs.magma.encyclopedia: Deal 1 damage to the holder or the melee target, depending on the part type of this material
material.kubejs.terracotta.encyclopedia: The tool has a random damage boost from 0 to (percentage of consumed durability × trait level) points
material.kubejs.lapis_lazuli.flavor: Keep mining! How do you know whether the block behind there is a stone or hidden treasures!
material.kubejs.lapis_lazuli.encyclopedi: Before the probability reach 0, each level can support you to mine 1000 blocks. The initial probability is constantly 20%
material.kubejs.redstone.flavor: Why does an energy-conducting material produce acceleration?
material.kubejs.redstone.encyclopedia: Consumes 1 redstone dust per shot. Accelerates projectiles by 5% per level
material.kubejs.amethyst.encyclopedia: Highlights surrounding targets of same type on attack. Effect range is a cube centered on target with side length = 4×trait level + 2×attack damage
material.tconstruct.glass.encyclopedia: While attacking, if damage is greater than 5 points, then it is possible to deal damage to enemies in 3×3×3 area. Sum of the damage dealt is equal to the damage to the direct damage
material.kubejs.paper.flavor: To the loyal readers of 'Puny Smelting': Not to cut your finger when turning pages
material.kubejs.paper.encyclopedia: Deals damage equal to armor value to attackers hitting from the side. Converts a portion of taken damage using armor toughness to counterattack
material.kubejs.kelp.encyclopedia: Recover 1 durability point every 3 seconds under water
material.kubejs.phantom_membrane.flavor: Why do phantoms always find night owls?
material.kubejs.phantom_membrane.encyclo: Continuously gain night vision effect in the dark, consuming 1 durability every 3 seconds
material.kubejs.sugar_cane.encyclopedia: Up to 25% chance to not consume durability when facing near the X-axis
material.kubejs.andesite_alloy.encyclope: Attack targets in a row with distances between them less than 3 blocks. Damage gets multiplied by 0.2 times trait level and stops conveying when being less that 1.
material.kubejs.sea_alloy.encyclopedia: Negates mining fatigue equivalent to the level of the Anti-Fatigue modifier
modifier.kubejs.welcome.description: Stats slightly boost during the first three days
modifier.kubejs.welcome.hint: The gift from %s has disappeared. Good luck!
modifier.kubejs.friable.flavor: Wash your hands after using the tool!
modifier.kubejs.friable.description: Durability drops even when you are not using it
modifier.kubejs.pottery.description: Randomly boost damage after tool is damaged
modifier.kubejs.uncertain.description: Ores sometimes duplicate themselves when no one notices after being mined. However, probability of this will reduce and reach 0 at last
modifier.kubejs.empower.description: Consumes Redstone Dust to provide additional initial velocity to projectiles
modifier.kubejs.resonance.description: Highlights surrounding creatures of same type on attack
modifier.kubejs.igniting.description: Conveys fire from one enemy to another
modifier.kubejs.thawing.flavor: Some kind of lite snowplow. Seemingly a little bit hot underfoot?
modifier.kubejs.glass_shard.description: Attack costs more durability points. When this happens, enemies near the direct target will be hurt
modifier.kubejs.fibrous.description: Chance to not consume durability when used along the X-axis direction
modifier.kubejs.papercutting.description: Only damages attackers that hit from the side
modifier.kubejs.algae.flavor: Long time ago, algae bricks are used to make alloys...
modifier.kubejs.algae.description: Tools are slowly repaired under water
modifier.kubejs.night_owl.description: Continuously gain night vision effect in the dark
modifier.kubejs.antifatigue.description: Counteracts mining fatigue effects. The maximum fatigue level negated is equal to this modifier's level
modifier.kubejs.warped.description: Grants protection in the Warped Forests
item.kubejs.artifact.startup.sword.name: Starter Sword
book.kubejs.material.recipes.missing: No recipes available for this material
book.kubejs.material.recipes.part_builde: Not craftable in the Part Builder. Used exclusively for tool repair
book.kubejs.material.recipes.casting.des: Craftable by pouring fluid into casts
book.kubejs.material.recipes.composite.d: Craftable by pouring fluid onto parts of other materials
